sec: Remaining AIDS-defining illnesses, category B, HIV in India and viral structure

items.q: Which parasitic disease is printed as AIDS defining?
AIDS-defining bacterial infections — match — 1) Mycobacteria 2) Salmonella … A) Salmonella septicemia B) Mycobacterium avium complex and Mycobacterium tuberculosis
items.exp: '5. Bacterial infections : mycobacterium avium complex, mycobacterium tuberculosis, · Salmonella septicemia'. (Book p1062)

items.q: How does the page label the category B conditions?
items.exp: 'CATEGORY B : Not AIDS defining illness'. (Book p1062)

items.q: Category B — match the site to the candidiasis — 1) Vulvovaginal 2) Oropharyngeal … A) Thrush B) Vulvovaginal candidiasis
How does the page define the constitutional category B criterion?
opts: Fever above 38.5 °C or diarrhoea lasting more than 1 month
Fever above 38 °C for more than 1 week
Weight loss of more than 5 kg
items.exp: '· Fever (>38.5°C) or diarrhea lasting >1 month'. (Book p1062)

items.q: Category B — match the condition to its group — 1) Haematological 2) Neurological 3) Mucosal … A) Idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura B) Peripheral neuropathy C) Hairy leukoplakia
items.exp: '· Idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura', '· Peripheral neuropathy' and '· Hairy leukoplakia' are all category B items. (Book p1062)

items.q: Which is NOT printed as a category B condition?
items.exp: Kaposi's sarcoma is an AIDS-defining malignancy; the others are category B. (Book p1062)

items.q: When was the first HIV case in India detected, and where?
items.exp: 'HIV in India : First case detected (Chennai) : 1986'. (Book p1062)

items.q: Which retroviral genus is printed for HTLV-1 on this page?
items.exp: 'Delta virus : HTLV-1' with adult T-cell lymphoma/leukemia and tropical spastic paraparesis. (Book p1062)

items.q: HTLV-1 associations — match — 1) Malignancy 2) Neurological … A) Adult T-cell lymphoma / leukemia B) Tropical spastic paraparesis
items.exp: 'Delta virus : HTLV-1 · Adult T-cell lymphoma/leukemia, · Tropical spastic paraparesis'. (Book p1062)

items.q: Lentiviruses — match — 1) HIV-1 2) HIV-2 … A) Less virulent, West African virus of the simian viridae family B) The main agent with groups and subtypes
items.exp: 'Lentivirus : · HIV-1, · HIV-2 : Less virulent, · Simian viridae family, West African virus'. (Book p1062)

items.q: Viral structure — match the component to its label — 1) Envelope 2) Enzymes 3) Capsid … A) Reverse transcriptase, integrase and protease B) gp120 and gp41 C) p17 matrix protein and p24 core protein
items.exp: 'Envelope : gp120, gp41'; 'Transcriptase (reverse), Integrase, Protease'; 'Capsid : Protein p17, p24'. (Book p1062)

items.q: Which HIV-1 subtype is printed as the most common?
Which HIV-1 subtype is printed as spreading through blood and among homosexuals?
items.exp: '→ B : Spread through blood, homosexuals'. (Book p1062)
